loop_contract.indexing: At cycle n, use rows 0 through 479 and add n*99.2 mm to every world X field; add n*4 seconds to timestamps. Row 480 is a closing endpoint for interpolation/validation, not an extra held sample.
loop_contract.interpolation: Monotone cubic with the same endpoint tangent on both sides of the seam. C1 continuity; acceleration continuity not guaranteed at every key.
loop_contract.start_stop_policy: The original full clip retains standing transitions. This loop must be entered/exited through a phase-matched transition, not an instantaneous command from stand.

completion.behavior: Finish the selected phase-matched exit and hold its terminal pose.

required_hardware_implementation: Apply execution-policy.json in the canonical calibrated actuator executor; neither this file nor timing.py emits servo commands.

loop_retiming.rule: Retiming must preserve the existing compiler matched entry/loop/exit joint positions and tangents; retain one closing knot without an extra dwell.
loop_retiming.world_coordinates: Use the existing loop translation rule for repeated body/foot/contact positions and phase-match exit translation to the selected cycle count. timing.py only maps source time.
loop_retiming.reference_derivative_scope: Phase demand arrays use full-source monotone cubic tangents; recompute exact extrema after compiler seam normalization and retiming.
